requirements.title: LEN STRING and KIND argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING shall be character; an unallocated allocatable variable or unassociated pointer STRING shall not have a deferred length type parameter; KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.LEN-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-express: Positive source plan uses KIND=selected_int_kind(18); source-control mutation changes KIND to a variable and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.definition: The LEN result is an integer scalar; KIND selects its kind type parameter and default integer is used without KIND.

requirements.title: LEN returns the number of characters in STRING or in one array element
requirements.definition: The LEN result equals the number of characters in scalar STRING or in an element of array STRING.

pending.LEN-scalar-character-length: Use character(len=5) scalar initialized to nonblank text and assert LEN returns 5, with mutation to LEN_TRIM detected by trailing blanks.
pending.LEN-array-element-character-length: Use character(len=3) rank-one array with distinct element contents and assert LEN(array)==3, proving element length rather than element count.
pending.LEN-zero-length-character: Use character(len=0) scalar and assert LEN returns 0, paired with the len=5 scalar companion so zero is not a vacuous only result.
pending.LEN-allocated-deferred-length-character: Allocate character(len=7) :: s for a deferred-length allocatable initialized to nonblank text, assert LEN(s)==7, and mutate the allocation length to 5 so the length inquiry is load-bearing.
pending.LEN-associated-deferred-length-pointer: Associate a deferred-length character pointer with a character(len=7) target initialized to nonblank text, assert LEN(pointer)==7, and mutate the target length to 5 so the pointer length inquiry is load-bearing.
